hotels.title: Hotels and accommodation places
hotels.description: Wikidata-listed hotels, resort hotels, hostels, guest houses and lodging entities. Not a complete hotel inventory.

aircraft-registrations.queryScope: Selected Wikidata classes and identifiers with per-dataset result caps; not an exhaustive global registry, and operating status is not inferred.
